title: Completed scalar pullback commutes with the actual whole-system counits
statement:
Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E and L of Q_ell, and a Q_ell-algebra embedding iota:E -> L [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let f:X -> Y be a scheme morphism with ell invertible in every residue field of both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let K be a derived-complete constructible integral E-coefficient object on Y [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write F_E,F_L for the specified completed integral pullbacks [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], S_X,S_Y for completed integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], and alpha:S_X F_E K -> F_L S_Y K for the specified scalarPullbackCompleted comparison, conjugated by its actual completion maps [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. Supply any proof hF that F_E K is derived complete. Let C be a simultaneous representative-normalized integral comparison system [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data]. For its reduction/total-limit adjunctions write R_E,W and R_L,W for reduction, U_E,U_L for whole-system derived pullback, and V_X,V_Y for whole-system scalar change. Let delta_F,E and delta_F,L be reduction of the prescribed pullback realizations followed by the actual adjunction counits; let delta_S,X and delta_S,Y be the analogous scalar counit maps. Let kappa:V_X U_E -> U_L V_Y be the generator-normalized whole-system scalar/pullback comparison, all as in [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data]. Then the following equality holds in the derived category of entire L-coefficient systems on X:
R_L,X(alpha) ; delta_F,L(S_Y K) ; U_L(delta_S,Y(K)) = delta_S,X(F_E K) ; V_X(delta_F,E(K)) ; kappa(R_E,Y K).
Here semicolons denote composition in the written order. All quotient transitions are retained; separate finite evaluations are not being used to detect equality. The coefficient sequence site, whole-system derived functors and normalized kappa are those of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]; the reduction/total-limit adjunctions are those of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus].

proof.text: Put W(false)=Y and W(true)=X. Apply normalizedCompletedOperationModels separately at E and L to obtain auxiliary completed-operation models. For each coefficient field, replace their calculus by the supplied C.coefficient system, their Roos models by the supplied ones, and their pullback realizations by those of C. Transport the auxiliary completion comparison by the unique isomorphism between the two left adjoints of the same coefficientSequenceLimit. The unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app equation verifies the completion-unit field. This constructs completed-operation models with exactly the prescribed calculus, Roos models and pullbacks; no uniqueness of arbitrary realization isomorphisms is asserted.

Apply ScalarExtensionTower.realizationModels to these models to supply the auxiliary normalized tensor models at Y. Residue-field invertibility implies invertibility in every local ring by the residue criterion and hence invertibility of l in global sections by the local unit criterion. Apply scalarExtensionTowerCoherence with the supplied scalar models of C and with both constructible inputs equal to K, and take its pullback equation. Unfold only pullbackReduction, scalarReduction and the two integralComparison counit definitions; they are the same reduction-of-realization followed by the same actual adjunction counit. Normalize composition association. Proof irrelevance identifies its supplied completeness proof with hF. This gives exactly the displayed entire-system equation.

theorem integralScalarPullbackCounit_compatibility
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (C : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (hF : IsSfDerivedComplete l E X ((integralDerivedPullback l E f).obj K.obj)) :
    ((C.coefficient L).system X).reduction.map
        (scalarPullbackCompleted l E L ι f K.obj K.property.1 hF).hom ≫
      (integralComparisonPullbackCounit l L f
        ((C.coefficient L).system Y) ((C.coefficient L).system X)
        ((C.coefficient L).roos X) ((C.coefficient L).pullback f)).app
          ((integralScalarExtension l E L ι Y).obj K.obj) ≫
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l L f).map
        ((integralComparisonScalarCounit l E L ι Y
          ((C.coefficient E).system Y) ((C.coefficient L).system Y)
          ((C.coefficient L).roos Y) ((C.scalar E L ι).model Y)).app K.obj) =
    (integralComparisonScalarCounit l E L ι X
        ((C.coefficient E).system X) ((C.coefficient L).system X)
        ((C.coefficient L).roos X) ((C.scalar E L ι).model X)).app
          ((integralDerivedPullback l E f).obj K.obj) ≫
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X).map
        ((integralComparisonPullbackCounit l E f
          ((C.coefficient E).system Y) ((C.coefficient E).system X)
          ((C.coefficient E).roos X) ((C.coefficient E).pullback f)).app K.obj) ≫
      (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι f).hom.app
        (((C.coefficient E).system Y).reduction.obj K.obj)

split_report.summary: The single remaining equation is the actual entire-system counit square, before lifting along the adjunction. It is needed to identify two specified comparisons, beyond abstract coherence. Edge cases: K=0 and empty schemes give zero arrows; f=id and iota=id reduce to the respective normalized units. Ramified extensions use derived change of rings and assume no quotient flatness. The isomorphism-only agreement node does not cover general f. The normalized-scalar-realization node describes a larger existential calculus, and the scalar tower theorem requires an auxiliary completed-operation model including tensor data; neither gives this supplied-C equation directly.
